headline: Senegal: Impeachment for high treason, a constitutional weapon without ammunition
summary: The PASTEF party is seeking impeachment of Senegal's head of state for high treason ahead of a resolution on a 19 November 2026 budget decree. The article notes the outcome will depend on the ballot box.
why: Budget decrees set public spending and fiscal targets, so political conflict over them can affect sovereign credit perceptions and debt markets.
original_headline: Sénégal : Mise en accusation pour Haute trahison, une arme constitutionnelle sans munition
